compression_level.description: Compression level for kgb archiver. Valid values: 0 (fastest, 2MB) to 9 (best compression, 1616MB). Default is 3 (18MB).

output_file.description: The filename for the resulting KGB archive. Must not exist before execution.

input_files.description: List of files or file listing references to be compressed. File listing references should start with @.
